_provenance.modeling_note: Full hand-authored damage model (5 hitboxes) following the repo mh60r_seahawk.json helicopter template pattern directly. Geometry scaled from the base Z-20 catalog leaf dimensions (length/rotor diameter approximated from the UH-60/Z-20 class, Tier B/C). Sonar and radar fields fully inlined per-mount in mounted_sensors/mounted_sonars, matching the mh60r_seahawk.json convention exactly (the underlying values are the same as the standalone CSG_CN_Z-20F_Radar/CSG_CN_Z-20F_Dipping_Sonar module records written earlier this packet, but the aircraft record does not reference them by name -- it duplicates their field values inline, since that is how the engine's DefaultUnitFactory parses mounted_sensors/mounted_sonars for any aircraft/helicopter unit). Twin engines share redundancy_group_id 'engine_cores'; main transmission gearbox, main rotor hub/blades, and tail rotor assembly/drive shaft modeled as distinct rotor/transmission components per the task's explicit instruction for helicopters. VTOL flight model: takeoff_speed/landing_speed/min_speed = 0.0 per the mh60r_seahawk.json convention.
